- env: Alembic environment for hmap.
- hmap: hmap — hierarchical multi-agent AI project execution platform.

- soak: Load / soak test (Sprint 4 item 4.20; reused by Member 11's release gate): N projects at once on the stub agents.
- cloud_check: Cloud key-pool check (doc 02 §2.5): does every cloud route in the role map still answer, and which keys work?
- demo_chaos: Failure-injection rounds against the running `make demo` stack (see demo_chaos.sh). Each round:
- demo_preflight: Pre-flight check of `make demo` (Sprint 9 item 9.16): is this laptop ready to run the whole platform?
- demo_sprint_1: Sprint 1 demo (DoD): upload a document -> stub pipeline -> human approval -> all tasks complete, all over the API.
- demo_sprint_2: Sprint 2 demo (Member 2, document intelligence): upload documents -> requirements with sources, over the API.
- demo_sprint_3: Sprint 3 demo (Member 3, planning): PDF -> requirements -> plan -> edit -> approve -> steps run in dependency
- demo_sprint_4: Sprint 4 demo (Member 4: self-reflection & refinement + observability), all over the API.
- demo_sprint_5: Sprint 5 demo (Member 5: autonomous research), all over the API, offline (cached corpus + recorded answers).
- demo_sprint_6: Sprint 6 demo (Member 6: research verification + security), all over the API, offline (recorded answers).
- demo_sprint_7: Sprint 7 demo (Member 7: autonomous coding), all over the API, offline (recorded answers).
- demo_sprint_8: Sprint 8 demo (Member 8: automated testing & execution), all over the API, offline (recorded answers).
- demo_sprint_9: Sprint 9 demo (Member 9: technical documentation), all over the API, offline (recorded answers).
- finetune_trial: Fine-tune TRIAL (process rehearsal for Sprint 11): LoRA on a small model with test-verified data.
- hmaptools: Team tooling (owner: Member 1): tree manifests, ownership checks, regression attribution. Standard library only.
- llm_check: LLM gateway smoke test (Sprint 1 DoD: "answers in live and replay modes").
- make_handoff: Make the folder snapshot that goes to the next member (doc 03 §2).

- backend/src/hmap/agents/testing/model.py: Artifact types, ids and the testing trace (Sprint 8, plan D12).
- backend/src/hmap/core/bus/base.py: Message-bus interface (research §22, §26, §27).
- backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/model.py: Data of the documentation agent (Sprint 9, plan D3, D11): the facts a repository really contains, the claims a document makes, and the trace of one run.
- backend/src/hmap/agents/testing/sandbox/__init__.py: Where generated code runs (Sprint 8 items 8.1 / 8.11, plan D1-D4, D11).
- backend/src/hmap/services/context/memory.py: In-memory ``ContextStore`` (Sprint 1 item 1.10, research §13-14).
- backend/src/hmap/agents/refine/stop.py: Stop policies (Sprint 4 item 4.6, plan D9): when does a refinement loop end?
- backend/src/hmap/core/ids.py: Identifier helpers.
- backend/src/hmap/agents/doc_intel/model.py: ``DocumentModel``: the normalised view of every uploaded document (spec §4), stored as the ``document-model`` artifact so the UI can show each requirement's source and highlight it.
- backend/src/hmap/agents/planning/model.py: Planning data that is not part of the shared ``TaskGraph`` contract: the ``plan-report`` artifact (how the plan was made, what was repaired, what is flagged, the schedule) and the in-progress plan the pipeline stages pass along.
- backend/src/hmap/core/contracts/common.py: Shared building blocks for every contract.
- backend/src/hmap/agents/research/corpus.py: The offline corpus (Sprint 5 item 5.14, plan D16): cleaned pages committed under ``samples/research/corpus/`` (permissive licences only, see ``samples/research/LICENSES.md``) plus anything fetched earlier into the local cache (``data/resear
- backend/src/hmap/agents/testing/stages/__init__.py: The stages of a test run (Sprint 8 items 8.2-8.6, plan D5), cheapest first:
- backend/src/hmap/agents/verify/model.py: Working records of the verifier (Sprint 6) and the ``verification-trace`` artifact body.

response.text: {"summary":"The platform is a hierarchical multi‑agent AI execution system (hmap) that orchestrates document ingestion, analysis, planning, refinement, research, coding and testing through a set of plug‑in agents. Core configuration and error handling live in `backend/src/hmap/core/config.py` and `backend/src/hmap/core/errors.py`, while the FastAPI entry point `backend/src/hmap/api/app.py` exposes the HTTP endpoints that drive the agents. Each agent implements a contract defined in the core contracts package (e.g., `backend/src/hmap/core/contracts/domain.py`) and registers its capabilities via `backend/src/hmap/core/plugins.py` and runtime discovery (`backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/discovery.py`). Supporting services such as in‑memory stores (`backend/src/hmap/services/artifact/memory.py`, `backend/src/hmap/services/context/memory.py`) and tracing (`backend/src/hmap/core/tracing.py`) provide persistence, observability and tracing across the pipeline. The repository also includes command‑line tools for building dashboards, running soak tests and generating documentation, tying together the various demo and sprint components into a cohesive AI workflow."}
